text:
Nora: Quick thought 30 rooftop happy hour this Friday 5:30? short shift-friendly, bring a snack to share. :clinking_glasses:
Ben: love it. can we request earlier for east-coast folks? 5:30 works for me.
Iris: i'll bring hummus + pita. any allergies to sesame?
Sam: i'm allergic to sesame  please no tahini-heavy dishes. i'll bring chips and seltzer.
Nora: noted - sesame-free snacks. Nora: we can reserve two high tables on the roof. weather looks clear so far.
Omar: can we do a two-song jukebox via phone? i'll queue a playlist.
Ben: +1 for music. quick poll - BYOB or team buys a round? react :beer: for BYOB, :money_with_wings: for team covers one round.
lunchbot: Poll posted: "Rooftop happy hour Friday 5:30 - BYOB or team covers one round?" React to vote. I'll post results at 3pm Friday.
Iris: :beer:
Sam: :beer: (BYOB ok)
Ben: :money_with_wings: (team covers one round)
Nora: looks like BYOB majority. Nora: still ok to put $30 team fund for snacks?
Omar: fine by me. will bring a Bluetooth speaker and a small extension cord for charging.
Sam: accessibility note - stairs only to rooftop, FYI.
Nora: thanks, will put in thread and sign post. Nora: backup indoor spot = mezzanine lounge if wind picks up.
Ben: can someone bring a small folding chair? im happy to bring one.
Iris: i'll bring LED string lights for ambiance. cheap battery ones.
Nora: perfect. final: rooftop Friday 5:30, BYOB, snacks potluck, music by Omar. Nora: i'll DM a reminder and bring a sign that says "Redwood Happy Hour".
lunchbot: Reminder set: "Rooftop Happy Hour" Friday 17:00 - will ping 30m before.
